**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/25 (Thu) 11:35
- [USER] The user inquired about a philosophical view regarding trust and consciousness.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The philosophical view that the only person you can truly trust is yourself is known as solipsism.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Solipsism is the idea that only one's own mind is certain to exist.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] According to solipsism, all external realities, including other minds, are uncertain and may not exist.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] According to solipsism, the only person you can trust to have a truly conscious and real existence is yourself.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Other people and external objects may be mere illusions or figments of your imagination.
